data.camera: medium shot, wink and peace sign
data.description: 【星野爱 · 电视录制】音乐番组录影棚里，星野爱一身白上粉下的双色裙装，对着镜头比出偶像手势，紫发间的水晶发饰闪着微光——「电视里的我，也要让大家心跳加速才行呢。」
data.promptProse: Ai faces the music-program camera with a wink and peace sign, wearing her white-and-pink two-tone stage dress and brown belt. A crystal hair ornament glints among her purple strands. The medium view keeps the studio floor and camera position readable with the set extending behind. Soft studio lamps spread even brightness across her gesture and collar, leaving gentle dress-fold shadows and small highlights in her star-shaped eyes.
data.title: 星野爱 · 电视录制
